title: Start a user service
summary: Start a background service that runs only for your current user account, not the whole system. Useful for user-specific daemons like notification servers or user-level sync tools.

steps.explain: Starts the specified service for the current user session.

placeholders.name: UNIT
placeholders.description: The name of the user service to start

steps.expect: The command returns without error if the user service starts successfully.
